topic: UX Metrics, Analytics, and Data-Driven Design
learningObjectives: Identify UX metrics that measure task success and user behavior.
Interpret basic product analytics for UX decisions.
Connect quantitative findings with qualitative research insights.

activities.title: UX Metrics Map
activities.instruction: Explore how common UX metrics relate to user goals.

content.concept: Metrics such as task completion, conversion, retention, error rate, and time on task provide different views of user behavior.

activities.title: Metric Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each design question with a useful metric.

content.concept: The right metric depends on the user behavior or product outcome being investigated.

activities.title: Analytics Explorer
activities.instruction: Adjust the data and observe the UX signal.

content.concept: Changes in behavioral data can reveal where users succeed, hesitate, abandon tasks, or encounter friction.

activities.title: Insight Synthesis Lab
activities.instruction: Combine research and analytics into an insight.

content.concept: Combining qualitative evidence with quantitative patterns creates stronger hypotheses about user problems and opportunities.
